resources_after_cleanup.unreleased_states_meaning: Search-owned handles whose drop was not confirmed; a terminated worker may already have freed their storage.

searches.cost_boundary: Search budget bounds admission and individual requests, including expanded-parent release and final verify. Advertised state/request capacity is checked before admission, reserving verify, live-handle cleanup and shutdown requests. Cleanup is separately bounded at 0.1 seconds per retained handle and included in this solve elapsed. Request/native action times are nested; worker startup/whole CPU are separate receipts.
searches.scope: Fixed deterministic local search; no learned routing or generalization evidence.
